# Server Operator

> Open source desktop app for managing servers over SSH: remote file tree with the Monaco editor, Docker and Compose logs, deploy presets, an integrated terminal and a local workspace mode. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. Licensed under Apache 2.0. Made by BeForth (https://beforth.in).

## Pages
- [Home](https://server-operator-zeta.vercel.app/): features, tech stack, project shortcuts, FAQ and downloads
- [Changelog](https://server-operator-zeta.vercel.app/changelog.html): what changed in every release
